Every type 2 case in MAM

Every row has a final guttural closing the last syllable of the first chanted word. The following chanted word has a separate column because its initial consonant selects the filter group.

Yeivin §354 says this mark is sometimes used when the following chanted word begins with lamed or nun. The filter separates those two initial consonants from all others.
